title: File-lock directories can write owner metadata through symlink escapes
description: packages/storage/src/file-lock.ts writes owner.json and heartbeat updates inside the caller-provided lockDir after mkdir(dirname(lockDir)), with no realpath containment guard. Search/runtime lock callers pass workspace lock paths such as .boreal/runtime/search-index.lock, so a symlinked runtime or lock directory can redirect lock metadata writes outside the workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: File-lock helpers validate the real path of the lock parent and existing lock directory before owner reads, writes, heartbeats, stale breaks, or release deletes.
Search/runtime lock callers provide or derive the expected workspace boundary consistently.
Regression tests cover symlinked state/search lock paths and prove no outside owner.json or heartbeat file is created.
